citation: 'To Rent—1811 Prairie-av., 16 room house; light on all sides; beautifully finished; 3 bathrooms, billiard and ball rooms; will decorate to suit tenant; 2 story stable. Holton, Seelye & Co., 204 Dearborn-st.' Classified advertisement, 'To Rent—Houses', Chicago Daily Tribune, 16 April 1904.
author: Holton, Seelye & Co. (advertiser), Chicago Daily Tribune
locator: Page index 9, the classified 'To Rent—Houses' column: the 1811 Prairie advertisement. The same agents repeat the wording in the Tribune of 1 September 1905 (per_chicago-daily-tribune_1905-09-01_64_209, page index 12): '1811 Prairie-av., 16 rooms with billiard and ball rooms, 2 story stable.'
rights_note: A US newspaper published in 1904, in the public domain. Read for a count of storeys and the house's state.
access_notes: Read 2026-10-25 (T-3099) from the item's OCR text ('TO RENT —1811 PRAIRIE-AV., 16 ROOM house: light on all sides ... suit Regt 2 story ... 2 able. OLTON, SERLYE & CO., 204 Dearborn-st.' — the stable's line is broken across the OCR's columns), which agrees with the Prairie library's transcription from the page image (chicago/prairie_1904_v1, image record npo-1811-tribune-1904-04-16-to-rent-16-room-billiard-ball). The 1905 repeat was read from that item's OCR text the same day ('16 rooins With billiard i ball ... 28s tory stable').
note: The scene year's own description of 1811: in April 1904 the house stood empty and was offered for rent, sixteen rooms detached on its lot ('light on all sides'), with a TWO-STOREY STABLE. The 1911 sheet draws the alley building as a 1½-storey brick garage; the stable of 1904, two storeys in this advertisement, in the 1905 repeat, on the 1891 Greeley-Carlson plate ('25', crossed) and in the Chicagology photograph (the pavilion with the arched door), is the building the scene stands (T-3099).
what_it_supplies: that 1811's alley building was a stable of two storeys in April 1904
that the house was detached, with light on all sides, and empty in spring 1904
what_it_does_not_supply: the stable's plan, roof or material
